<div class="diatribe-meta">Book II · 1 paragraph · <span class="canonical" title="Canonical reference">II 25</span></div>

<div class="title-note">Note on the title<a class="note-ref" id="noteref-1" href="#note-1" role="doc-noteref" aria-label="note 1"><sup>1</sup></a></div>

<nav class="chapter-nav"><a href="2-24.html">Previous discourse</a><a class="chapter-home" href="../index.html">Home</a><a href="2-26.html">Next discourse</a></nav>

<div class="paragraph-list">
<p>WHEN one of those who were present said, Persuade me that logic is necessary, he replied, Do you wish me to prove this to you? The answer was—Yes.—Then I must use a demonstrative form of speech.—This was granted.— How then will you know if I am cheating you by my argument? The man was silent. Do you see, said Epictetus, that you yourself are admitting that logic is necessary, if without it you cannot know so much as this, whether logic is necessary or not necessary?</p>
</div>
